outcome_evidence: The oven is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, then pulls the door outward and downward (frames 91–110, image and left_ego_image). By frame 111 the door is lowered and the oven interior is exposed; it remains open through frame 150 as the gripper withdraws (image and left_ego_image, with withdrawal also visible in wrist_image). No failed acquisition, damage, or displacement of unrelated objects is visibly established.
